logo_override.validation_detail: jpeg 1000x252, full colour (green AfDB/AfDF seals + dark 'AFRICAN DEVELOPMENT BANK GROUP' wordmark) on white background; not white-on-transparent

notes: webfetch was blocked (403 Cloudflare bot rule, and page fetches timed out), so discovery and probing were done with Playwright. The site header logo img on the JADS page is https://www.afdb.org/sites/default/files/afdb-logo-en_1.jpg with alt 'African Development Bank Group' - same registrable domain, first-party path under /sites/default/files. Probed by loading the asset directly in a tab: real image decoded, naturalWidth/naturalHeight 1000x252, complete=true, and the browser network log recorded HTTP 200 (no HTML error page). Rendered the asset and confirmed it is the multicolour African Development Bank Group lockup on white, so it does not trip the white-on-transparent wordmark ban. Rejected the og:image/twitter:image (bannerjads.jpg - JADS banner, not a logo) and link rel=mask-icon asset afdb_logo_gray.svg (monochrome grey, not the full-colour primary lockup).
